title: Tooling: 9.31x faster exact four-flat maximal-mask filtering
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The four-flat decoder checker removes contained setup masks by comparing every candidate against every other candidate. This adds an opt-in cardinality-bucket filter: compare a candidate only with already retained, strictly larger maxima, then restore the original mask order. A short induction proves exact maximal-set and ordered-output equivalence.

**Tooling improvement.** No new pruning rule, decoder exclusion, supplier or kappa. Both measured engines retain PR2975's same option generator. The change targets a different setup bottleneck.

| Same-input workload | Reference | Accelerated | Speedup |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Maximal-mask filtering, both representatives | 104.85 s | 11.26 s | 9.31x |
| Complete per-representative setup | 107.28 s | 13.55 s | 7.92x |
| Full bounded run, shared catalogue/orbits included | 156.74 s | 61.42 s | 2.55x |


Complete setup-state bytes agree for all 2,572 active direction records and 2,380,184 maximal masks. All eleven downstream requirement records, the complete output/histogram reporting 5,509 closure leaves, and the known relaxed span-five positive witness also agree. Only compact receipts are committed.

## Task and overlap

Refined `replay-runtime`, OS seed94. Scientific base `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455`; synchronized submission base `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`. Revision6 guidance was read; this card, selected record and all seven runtime inputs are unchanged.

Exact dependencies: PR2975 `1d7b491c9efad451d49dbfd36a3be7443999bf17`, retaining DreamingOfClouds' help package `1b25759bff5486293a9083ebbe0097b5f6642e08`. Scope is representatives46/94 setup for `(a,b,c,d)=(4,6,4,5)`, the existing twelve representative46 pairs, and the known `(6,6,4,0)` positive control. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2954#discussioncomment-18977655). PR2985's residue-closure/input-coverage work is distinct and is not assumed here. No full class-C campaign is launched.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-flat-maximal-masks
```

Expected `PASS_MAXIMAL_MASK_CONTROLS`, `PASS_MAXIMAL_MASK_FULL`, and registered-package success. Requires GNU C11/unsigned128 `cc` and sanitizer-trap support; Python standard library only.

- Registered Python3.12 controls and complete differential replay pass.
- Independent explicit-set oracle: all 65,536 four-point families plus 2,128 wide-mask cases; sanitizer-trap run agrees.
- Six implementation mutants reject; source-byte, adapter-anchor, invalid-input and complete-export controls pass.
- Read-only Git-free optimized Python3.14 controls agree. Publication-byte preflight passes.

Timings are serial local Linux/GCC measurements, not a universal performance guarantee or multiplication-runtime claim. The full comparison shares predecessor catalogue, orbit, feasibility and rank code; those mathematical premises, RRC and supplier/all-size obligations remain unaudited here. Hosted CI and independent human/formal-kernel review are separate.

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds for the four-flat engine, original mask construction, request and #2816/#2826/#2862 lineage; PR2975 for the separately retained requirement-enumeration improvement. Tekalign (@tekuuu), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in analysis, implementation, checks and writing. Apache-2.0. Frozen predecessors and shared code are unchanged.

## Open next questions

The [package](https://github.com/tekuuu/integer-mult-bounds/tree/4c0cf223e3e4a06099704b34202a5015f1ab1e62/research/four-flat-maximal-masks) contains the proof, exact pins, receipts and next questions (10 files, 900 added lines; the filter is 38 lines). A stronger exact orbit reduction or common-flat gate is still needed to make the full campaign affordable; the smallest next experiment is a bounded slice with a proof that the gate preserves every possible span witness.
